content: Task ledger update: Evaluate comm+hermes combine without breaking Hermes CLI command surface. Completed evaluation artifact docs/plans/comm-hermes-combine-evaluation.md. Verified cargo test -p annunimas-comm, focused cargo test -p annunimas-cli hermes, and queue append-only guard.
